description.ncbi_summary: Predicted to enable cation channel activity. Predicted to be involved in cation transmembrane transport. Predicted to be integral component of membrane. Predicted to be integral component of plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: May assemble to form gap junction channel-like structures involved in intercellular communication. Channel gating and ion conductance are likely regulated by membrane lipids rather than by membrane depolarization or extracellular calcium levels.
